title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

title: Robinhood Chain considers technology that gives paying traders priority
summary: Arbitrum recently replaced its Timeboost transaction-ordering system with a new model called Priority Gas Auctions.

title: New York AG secures up to $35 million and lifetime crypto ban from Celsius’ Alex Mashinsky
summary: Alex Mashinsky, already serving 12 years for fraud, settled New York’s civil case over claims he misled Celsius customers about the failed crypto lender’s safety.

title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
summary: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

title: DWF Labs subsidiaries sue BitGo for $141 million over alleged token lock-up breach
summary: DWF is seeking $114 million in damages on the basis BitGo’s token sales resulted in direct losses through the fall in tokens' prices.
